common.style_usage: the exact Stardew Valley town building style and PIXEL SCALE of these houses: doors, windows, boards and shingles must be exactly this size; square-on front view from above
reference_images: layout and outline: low roof across the top, wall below with the big window on the left and the full-size door under a porch roof at the right; keep this size and layout exactly
the look to keep: cream boards, sage shingle roof, stone chimney, arched door with a round window, ivy on the left corner, pink flower box; but draw it at the reference houses' larger pixel scale

cottage_v3a.description: Stardew Valley town building at exactly the pixel scale of the reference houses: a small, low cottage six tiles wide and five tall, drawn square-on from the front and above. A low sloped sage green shingled roof seen from above across the top half, with a small stone chimney. Cream painted wooden boards. The face we see is the back of the house: one big multi-paned picture window with a flower box of pink flowers, and at the right end, under a little porch roof, an arched wooden door with a small round window, exactly as big as the doors of the reference houses (20 pixels wide, 34 tall). Ivy climbing the left corner. Dark coloured (not black) outlines, transparent background
